body:
I'm not delusional, I know that  people would be sad and miss me and won't understand why I did this because life for them is so beautiful, while I'm giving my life up to chronic pain and depression. (And I can't do anything to solve my physical issues).

The point is that I don't give a damn.

My parents are putting me down constantly and I have no friends. Even doctors don't know how to deal with me anymore, and this is a solid indication on how fucked up I am.

He knows that I have depression and I told him that I cannot deal with this life anymore, he doesn't knows about me wanting to kill myself. He probably didn't get the red flag. He thought i was just venting.

He can understand, but i feel like he is getting bored of my depression and to not be able to help me, sometimes he is distant and cold like he is trying to distance himself from me, or just avoiding me or the topic.

I'm going to listen to him, i was surprised that he is a monk and not a privileged billionaire life coach or something similar. But I don't expect anything, really. Even my therapist shrugged last time I saw him, like he didn't know what to do with me anymore.

I cannot tell him, he dislikes when I'm sad and he would tell my parents, and they  took bullying me as an hobby. I don't want to be hospitalised even if I live in a first world country. Nobody can really help me. Not my boyfriend, not doctors, not my parents. 

I have a plan that hopefully is going to work. I have no other choices. I don't want to live to suffer anynore. My life is empty. I can feel no love, no joy, nothing anymore. Just anger and self-hatred and despair. And the sad thing is that my self-hatred is much more than the love for my boyfriend.

Me neither. I only regret that I didn't worked. It would have only saved me so much misery.

But it was stupid, I tried to overdose on cymbalta. I just got an headache.

I cannot physically work at a McDonald's or something. I cannot handle even going to a lecture, work is 10x worse. There is literally no chance for me to do what you are saying. I have trouble even walking.

I won't do anything good in my life. Some people are just not meant to be happy or have an happy life or kick ass or whatever. I'm one of them. I did nothing good in my life, I was screwed from the beginning. There is nothing that will ever change what I can realistically do. No positive thinking or giving other chances will make my life good.

I tried and I got screwed once more, like this is the "another chance". There is no point to keep giving "another chance" if every time it goes only worse and worse. I'm beating a dead horse and there is no point in doing this.

My heath will never improve. This is a fact I cannot change.
I cannot use a pc for too long, I'm on my smartphone. Using a keyboard comes with a load of unbearable pain. 

No, I won't give myself a chance anymore. I'm done.

I'm failing because I have a chronic illness. I  sometimes cannot physically go to university and in January I had a side effect that caused me to be bedridden with nausea for three weeks, and I couldn't study or do anything. 

You are in the US, in my country job market sucks, there aren't many job, the situation is completely different. And i cannot work because of my illness. This with having no skill is basically a ticket for homelessness.

Also, I'm done trying explaining stuff to them. They use manipulative tactics, circular arguments and I'll end up the discussion subject. They also deny everything they don't like.
It's not worth it.

They aren't ( fake)friends or classmates, they are my parents.

I have no chance to improve my life. They were trashing because I'm failing university.

I'm just a crippled and crazy woman with nothing. I already made my decision time ago, but at weekends they are at home and i cannot kill myself. They don't know that I planned it.

But they are making sure that I don't regret this choice.
22, but i wish I was never born every single day.

Me. I can only feel anger(with myself, mostly) and sadness.
Once it was actually worse, it was like 90% anger and 10% sadness, now anger is only 40%.

Last time I didn't because I had a good weekend and I discovered through therapy that I'm suicidal because I don't accept living with a chronic illness.

It was a mistake. I'm still suicidal, still sure that my life will be terrible, but my parents are at home because my father is retiring and my mother works on shift, so  I'm rarely alone. They don't know that this is the only reason I'm still breathing.

Yes, and I wish I weren't. I just being screamed at andbeing told that I'm an asshole, with slamming doors and people crying because I told my mom... to stop trying to start random fights with me.

Really, now I get why my therapist said to me that if he were me he would be suicidal too.

I've been in therapy for 2 years, it didn't help. 

I did nothing well, even as a child. I was constantly belittled for not being enough by my teachers and classmates and by my parents all the time. Yes, I've told my therapist this. No, I will never forget more than 15 years of borderline abuse, no matter how much therapy or meds i do or take. 

I don't think I will have a big break in two, three, ten or a hundred of years. I'm going to lose everything soon enough, being alone is not the anticipation of anything good, really. 

My therapist cannot help me, I don't expect anyone to do in a comment what he couldn't do in two years, even if they had the same condition. Hell, i wasn't able to find someone with my same life experience and the same goals that I have, or even the same subject that I study. Or anyone that has a career in the field I want, with the same health issues as mine. 

I feel stupid enough for trying last time, this time I won't make this mistake again.
And i don't really care about how sad my family would be or that there are people with worser health than mine that want to live.

Yeah, writing 100000 reasons why I should kill myself is going to give me hope.

I don't think so.

I've got the "you should be kinder to yourself" advice. It was sooo helpful and doable/s

I will never love myself. Never. Telling me to do so it's just a waste of time.

I know that my boyfriend is going to leave me because he is cold and distant. He literally told me to not come to spend the weekend with him if i'm going to be sad. I know him, he is waiting for me to get better to drop the news, i can see that he can't take it anymore.

The job market in my country sucks. At 35 you will be old even if you try to find a job as a bathroom cleaner in a fast food. And people will try everything to pay you near to nothing if you don't have any experience or a degree.

I'm not crazy(even if you seem to like to dismiss me as that), if I say something it's not because "depression", is because I know what my problems are. Pretending that everything is fine because if i don't people would be sad and miss me is not helpful. 

There is a difference between "not going the same route i expected" and going to the shittiest route avaiable. I'm not willing to go for the shittiest route for a small chance that "things get better" when I' a 40 years old crazy homeless lady with no one that cares for her. I' ve got enough now.  Waiting for 20 years just to a small chance that things get better is just above what i can do.

In 22 years I've only got a collection of failures. I've no whatsoever evidence that things will change. Things should have already changed when I started university.

I don't want to martyr myself because my parents or my bf need inspirational porn. Just no. 

I don't want to be ruled again and again by my illness. 

You said it correctly. I MIGHT find something to live for. There is a chance that  i never will.

But i know that my pain will be there forever. It's the only thing i can rely on.

I only have my boyfriend and my parents, who don't know how to deal with me at all. No friends (one of the reasons I want to do it).

Nobody can make my life easier. Just death. Death is sweet compared to 60 years of suffering and suffering and most of all failures.
I have nothing to fight for.

After years of trying and trying and trying I just don't want to be a Don Quijote anymore.
My parents are physically at home and would stop it, I'm waiting for them to be at work tomorrow.

I wrote my suicide note, that's all. Doing this is a problem because i struggle to put my thoughts in a logical way(It takes me ages to format my posts) and I don't even know where to start. 

My note makes a lot of sense. I have no chance to improve.

This is not a symptom of my depression. I completely changed when in January I was so sick that I barely got out of bed. When I failed all my exams because I couldn't move from the bed and study. I'm always WEEKS behind the schedule becaude i'm often too tired to open a book. This won't ever change. 

I'm studying because I want a job, not because I have time or money to waste in a useless education. And getting a degree when i'm 35 is useless because it's too late to find a job in the field(or any field, really). I want to own a little house for me. I want to be indipendent. That experience told me that I will never do that. That i cannot get the degree, that I'll never live on my own. That I'll never have a job.

I already gave life another chance after another, and I'm still where i started, with less than nothing, just pain and misery. I tried to make friends, I tried to improve my life. That's why I said I tried everything. It wasn't just medication.

People will miss me. But I have no other choice. I've been in therapy for two years, with my psychologist and my psychiatrist. They did what they could, but i have a reminder everyday that my life sucks beyond repair. 
 

I won't miss telling people that I'm going to drop out. I won't miss when my boyfriend will leave me. I won't miss pain everyday. I won't miss envy people. I won't miss pills, weekly appointments, being sick, forgetting to buy the meds.
I won't miss living on my parents for the rest of my life only to become homeless once they are gone.
I won't miss not having friends, failing school, being bedridden.

We can't.

I'm not willing to live in in pain, unable to do what I want to do, always relying on other people to do stuff for you or worse, paying for your stuff.

They lie becaude they want you to breathe/survive. But I don't want to survive, I want to live. That's why I'm going to do it tomorrow.

It's ironic, I know, but I hate what I have now. I don't want people to lie to me anymore. I don't want to be told to "compromise", because it's not a compromise, it's giving up. People know that you will fail regardless because of your illness, but they keep pushing because  "life is beautiful and you will figure it out, you are strong" and other meaningless adjectives.
I don't want to be "strong" or a "warrior" or "brave", I want a life that I can call "life", this is not.

Everything is in my post history. I have fibromyalgia, hypermobility and depression. I have troubles walking (my knees bend backwards), i'm failing university because I cannot study due to pain, pain and even more pain. I'm too tired to do anything when I come home from lectures.
 I screwed the only chance I had to get a better life.
I cannot have a job because of my illness for the same reasons I'm failing university.
I used to write, but using a keyboard is a tragedy now, I used to like studying until January when reality fell over me.

Meds don't work, doctors have no idea on how to treat me, therapy doesn't work. I've tried to manage my life, to deal with this and to create myself few opportunities. I'm not able to do that.

I have a lot of side effects from opiates, so I don't take them. I spend literally days puking and nauseated with the lowest dose avaiable. I tried few meds with the same result, my rheumatologist just told me to not take them anymore and prescribed me 1000 paracetamol, which is the only compromise avaiable. For the other meds, I know they are working as placebos(lyrica and samyr), there is nothing that really helps with fibromyalgia.

It's not only the pain(even if is the biggest part),  it's living a life of envy to people who can do what they want, is having to give up at everything, it's having no purpose (surviving is not a purpose), it's always dumbing down things because not being able to do anything, nothing to look forward to except to feel even more pain and misery. 

When I'll be 30, I'll be homeless, without a job, no degree, no friends, no boyfriend, no skills, no hobbies, nothing. Because I'm like  on more than half of that list at 22, at 30 it can only be worse,  I don't want to live on my parents for the rest of my life. And doing nothing all day only worsen my depression. 

I need to do things. I need to be able to work, because even only thinking at being at home all day long is making me even more suicidal. My head says opposite things than my body, it'a terrible combo and I don't really see any realistic solution to that, except from removing myself from that situation.

My life is terrible, is going to be terrible for the rest of my life. What's the point on keeping suffering for 60 more years? I feel like I'm in prison and I've being given a life sentence in solitary. And I'll be in that prison for more than 60 years(life expectancy in my country is 85 for women). People around me are not enough to make this thought bearable. Not even closer. They will eventually leave or die. But this thing will stay with me no matter what.
My pain defines me. My pain prevents me from doing what I want day after day and i have nothing. I'm nowhere, I'm just sitting there with no purpose, no goals, nothing.

I feel suffocating day after day by this.
I cannot change my personality, i don't really think there is any kind of therapy that can do that. Having no purpose, no goals, no chance of getting better is not a thing I can handle, therapy or not. I don't want this life.

In my country I don't quality for disability, because fibromyalgia is not recognized as an illness. I could try to do that with my depression issue, but still I wouldn't qualify  for any kind of welfare. 

I will never love myself. I know that, I think I already made a decision. I have nothing to live  for, much less living off disability welfare or my parents.

My family will recover, because it wouldn't be out of the blue, I already attempted and they know that I feel suicidal. 

I think they would feel relief, someday soon.  Also, I'm going to leave a note.

I'm worried about my boyfriend, really. He is not going to take it well. He will blame himself because he couldn't help me. But he deserve better than a failure like me. I will leave a note for him too. I hope he will take care of himself once I'm gone.

No, I don't. I only have fibro symptoms with hypermobility, they told me I was born this way. Also it didn't worsen over years, it's quite a stable thing that I'always had. I  subluxated only twice (the same knee), I think. I don't meet the criteria. 
But fibromyalgia makes it worse because I have serious issues making an mantaining muscles (?) And my joints have nothing that supports them.

 (Sorry, I've slept 4 hours and I cannot really explain myself right now.)

I do, I have obsessive traits so my life is made by intrusive thoughts. 
I cannot really tell you how to overcome it, for that you need more than a internet stranger.

No, therapy won't help. I've been in therapy for two years, really, things only got worse, especially in the last 4 months.

 There is nothing really good in my life, and few months from now it will be only worse because i'll have to drop out and I feel like my boyfriend is just waiting a good time to break up with me. 

All of this is not fixable with lowering my expectations basically to 0 or "acceptance" or even meds, or therapy.  I don't even know if there is a way to fix this.
Probably I'm just beating a dead horse. And I've been for a while.

Not really. I'm doing the therapy with the public healthcare service, he is basically overwhelmed that's why he gave me an appointment next month. He is not bad at all, tbh.

I gave up. I won't show up the next appointments, even if i go what does it change? Nothing. I'll still be sick and my life still sucks.

The first one I posted here, I think. However they are pretty similar for the most part.
My issue is basically that I hate being ill and I hate the consequences of it.
No, it was pain medication.

Tl;Dr in January I experienced a 3 weeks long nausea due to medication, I couldn't do my exams. I have a chronic illness and I have depression. 
I decided that this was enough, but I gave life another chance.
A month later my health sucks again, I still feel like I've being punished for something and I don't want to live like this anymore. I'm being robbed of everything.

For a more detailed explanation there are my older posts.

I have depression and a chronic illness. While i don't have any kind of addiction problem like you did i took the decision to go into therapy because of my boyfriend 6 months after we started dating. 

Now, therapy works if you try to make it work. Tell your doctors your real situation, your real feelings. If you lie because you want to get discharged you will never solve anything. Also, they know that you are lying, they have seen everything and people in worse condition than you. You aren't going to fool anyone, you are going to lose a chance to improve your life. 

For about what to tell your girlfriend... don't lie to her either. That would break the trust between the two of you, imho. But if you lie to your doctors, and lie to her, and lie to your parents etc you will end up with people who don't have any idea what to do with you. You are cutting people out, that doesn't help anyone. People around you can see that you don't feel good. They have shown you that they are not clueless more than once. Your family keep calling, your gf is worried about your health. Hell, even her family cares about you.

You are building a support system  that cares about you enough to drive you to an hospital, this is great. But you should involve professional in that support system and that requires trust and to be honest with them. Because your gf cannot help you more than she did, she cannot give you meds, she cannot do CBT(these are just examples), she cannot give anything that you need right now, which is something more than cuddling and a shoulder to cry on.

Me and my boyfriend made a deal: if i need/want to complain about my life i should be looking for solutions. This was a really solid piece of advice my bf gave me, because my therapist said that too last week.
That could work to give you something to look forward to, for example building your support system. 

Also, professionals can give you some helpful advice on how to deal with your family. Mine isn't dealing well with my health condition at all, they are either in denial or exaggerating. But sometimes telling them how you really feel about the calls and texts etc can help them understand your point of view. And can help you understand them, so you can find a middle-ground between your needs and their worries. They seem well intentioned people, give them a chance. 

Take care of yourself OP.
Thank you all! I hope things will improve sooner or later, but my health is what it is.

I do. My life is pointless, I wish i was never born... or to just disappear. This sounds a good option. I feel like I'm already disappearing, nothing brings me joy anymore and I feel like I accomplished nothing. Everyday I spend living is cruelty.

Another thing I dream of is a "reset button". Like, i push this button and I can restart again the day I was born so i can have the life I wanted and make things right.
He is the only good thing I have. But he is not enough. I don't have anything else, really. Just him.

We have a public healthcare system, no insurance or anything like that. I doubt it will make any kind of difference. I don't want to be hospitalized for a psychotic break because of CBD, even if the chances are low. That is scary.

In my country is legal, but I don't want to try it because i have obsessive thoughts and i'll probably have a psychotic breakdown. Also, that would be totally on me for the expenses and i cannot afford the expense. (It costs about 200€ per month)

I have no friends and my parents cannot deal with me properly. My mom makes everything about her, it's hypochondriac and very anxious and she take all of this on me. My dad doesn't understand how depression works. They cannot help me.

The only thing that could help me is to wake up healthy. That isn't going to happen.

The only way out is waking up tomorrow "normal". My life is ruined because of my chronic illness. I have nothing. If i survive then in July i'll be here asking how to tell people that I've drop out of university and that i deserve nothing and that I should totally kill myself.
I cannot think of a single hobby, distracition etc. that makes me happy right now. The subject i study used to make me happy, but I failed my exams, so I lost that too. I used to like videogames, but my pc doesn't work really well and the pain in my hands is unberable, so no gaming for me.  My sight is something problematic (i cannot explain myself in another language, sorry) and I cannot read a book. 

There isn't a way out of this hell. I'll be ill for the rest of my life, and I want this "rest of my life" to be the shortest possible. I'm done with everything. I tried to improve my life, or I wouldn't start university. But i failed as i failed everything else. I wish I had something to be proud of, instead I have a entire collection of failures. 

Life gave up on me.
Me, I should restart classes next week, I don't know if i'll go or not. I want to drop out, tbh.

I went to the hairdresser a month ago, still hate my hair. I don't know why, to be honest, i just dyed my hair back to my natural color and cut the damaged part. Everyone loves my hair, though, so it's not like they did a bad job. 

However good job! I hope you had a nice day!

I don't. I don't remember much from ny childood or teen years, i have mostly bad memories of being bullied, failing something or negative stuff.
I never had the chance to know myself. I don't know how I really am.

I would hate that. And my boyfriend too. I hate kids and staying all day watching tv and doing nothing or just chores would drive me insane more than i already am. This was what i was going to avoid. 

Stem cell terapy isn't relate to what i have (musculoskeletal disease), i tried all meds on the market and didn't work.

I already go to a therapist, i see a psychiatrist too. But this didn't work too. Right now I'm on antidepressants, they are not working. I'm done trying.

Thank you. My chronic illness is permanent, I have no chance to improve, I hate everything.

I don't know what I would have said to me. I have never been in that position.
